answer: New identities start at zero and must accumulate real work before earning voting weight, while the opal staking bond locks collateral that is slashed on detected duplication. Each agent must burn a unique on-chain ember token to register, with the burn receipt tied to a slowly decaying lotus score that reflects verified history. An attacker running N sybils pays N burns plus N bonds, making mass reputation slot creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
